research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: General Radar Corp. is engaged in developing multi-purpose radar systems featuring electronically steered transmit/receive elements and digital signal processing, as described in Multi-purpose radar system. Their work also includes compact analog beamformers and microwave radar systems with linear antenna arrays and Rotman lenses, as detailed in Compact analog beamformers and microwave radar systems containing the same. These efforts focus on high resolution mm-wave radar technologies for automotive applications.

product.name: Mark-IV
product.description: A 3D imaging radar operating in the 76~81GHz band designed for autonomous vehicles, counter-drone, airfield FOD, and wind-profiling applications. It features a narrow electronically-steered beam and high-resolution imaging.
